أسترأف (form X)
# أُسْتَرْأَفُ (ʔustarʔafu) /ʔus.tar.ʔa.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
# أُسْتَرْأَفَ (ʔustarʔafa) /ʔus.tar.ʔa.fa/: first-person singular non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
# أُسْتَرْأَفْ (ʔustarʔaf) /ʔus.tar.ʔaf/: first-person singular non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَرْأَفَ (istarʔafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
